p: myBRO (store name "BFI RO Tools", app folder ro_tools/ in bfi-finance/bravo-ro-tools-apps) is the internal app for repeat-order submissions. It is the second largest BFI mobile code base: 112,371 hand-written Dart lines in 754 files, 29 feature folders, 94 controllers. It was split out of the agency monorepo in December 2025 and still carries copies of five of its shared packages. It ships about every nine days and is used: 78,554 Datadog RUM sessions on version 3.50.3 in the last 30 days. This page compares it with the DK Jago app the same way as the GENFI, SQUARE, MyShaf and MY BISPRO pages, and maps its work onto the Agency apps roadmap: shared phases.

li.p: A workflow prints fields of the Play Store service-account key.debug.yml (added 9 Apr 2026, no PR, still active, 1 run) interpolates BRAVO_GCP_SA_KEY into shell six times and prints its client_email, project_id and private_key_id with jq. GitHub masks only the whole secret, not these fields. The private key itself is not printed. The same key uploads to Play in deploy-prod.yml and is an org secret in 51 repos.

UAT was opened for a pentest and never closed. PR #456 (2 Sep 2026, one approval) made two one-line changes: FLAG_SECURE now only in prod, the system proxy now honoured in every non-prod flavour. The TODO says "will be delete soon". SIT builds additionally have no certificate pin and no obfuscation.

Checks do not gate merges.master requires 1 approval and no status checks, admins are not enforced, code-owner review is required but there is no CODEOWNERS file. The PR pipeline failed on 4 of the last 5 runs, including both runs for the branch that became v3.50.3, the current production tag. All 8 GitHub environments have zero protection rules.

The coverage number hides the rules.scripts/combine_coverage.dart excludes every *_controller.dart. The 94 controllers hold 27,560 lines and the business logic. 28 of them have a test. No threshold anywhere.

The app package has no lint rule set.ro_tools/analysis_options.yaml has no include: line, so the root strict_lint.yaml reaches only the shared packages. The README's "very_good_analysis" claim is wrong. Read from the files, not verified by running the analyzer.

Root detection is half dead. The Dart side calls a root_detection method channel that MainActivity.kt never registers, so the KernelSU check always returns false. The jailbreak fork works. No Play Integrity or App Attest. The debug build type is signed with the release keystore.

Architecture is the GENFI gap at larger scale. 95 StateNotifier controllers, no domain layer, *Response DTOs in 46 screens and 71 controllers, 198 cross-feature imports with 8 two-way cycles, lib/app importing lib/features in 26 files. Two calculator controllers of 2,589 and 2,321 lines.

Observability sends personal data. Datadog setUserInfo sends the login id (likely the NIK), name and email. Firebase Analytics default parameters include agent_name on every event. Consent is hard-coded granted. DDService.e attaches a free-form request map to 159 error calls with no sanitiser.

Shared packages have drifted.core, sso and keycloak are 16 to 42 lines behind the agency copies (interceptor hook, correlation-id capture, web multipart). ui_theme and the pinning fork are identical. Nobody owns the sync.
iOS cannot be assessed from this repo. No iOS workflow, no Info.plist in git. The store listing has no iOS entry.

td.p: Melos workspace, feature and shared packages, thin *_api contracts.

Melos workspace (config in the root pubspec): one app plus five packages copied from the agency monorepo. lib/app holds 42,012 lines of data layer, widgets and utilities and imports lib/features in 26 files. 198 cross-feature imports over 66 pairs, 8 two-way. core, sso, keycloak have drifted from the agency copies.
Pick one source for the shared packages (a published package or a git subtree) before any refactor touches them twice. Feature packages later.
data → domain ← presentation. Domain is pure Dart.

app/data/<area>/repository + model and features/<f>/screen + controller. No domain folder. Repositories are reached only from controllers (good), but *Response DTOs reach 46 screens and 71 controllers. The rules sit in the two calculator controllers (2,589 and 2,321 lines) and contact_list_controller (1,300).
Domain for the loan proposal and offering calculations first. Mappers at the repository edge.

Riverpod 2.6 legacy: 95 StateNotifier, 0 Notifier, 145 ConsumerStatefulWidget, 300 ref.listen. Provider as static final on the class. NavigationService singleton for the navigator key. Two provider observers (Datadog, Crashlytics).
Keep Riverpod. Riverpod 3, then Notifier, the same sequence as the agency apps.
injectable + get_it, wiring in the app layer.

ProviderScope with 6 overrides in main.dart. The auth client (SsoHttpClient or KeycloakHttpClient) is chosen by the Remote Config value roFfSsoLogin, read through AppController, default Keycloak until the fetch returns. No interfaces beyond core.HttpClient.
Ports. Make the auth choice a build-time or start-up decision, not a watched provider.

AnalyticsServices wrapper over Firebase Analytics, 24 named events (mixed English and Indonesian, e.g. user_click_lanjutkan), 27 call sites, user id and user_role property, FirebaseAnalyticsObserver and DatadogNavigationObserver on the shell route. Default parameters carry the whole user json including agent_name. A clamp sanitiser (25 params, 100 chars), no PII redaction.
Closest to the target of the five apps. Add the Datadog fan-out, typed parameters, and drop agent_name from default params.
Monitoring fans out to Crashlytics and Datadog. PII sanitiser.

Crashlytics in every flavour, no custom keys, recordFlutterError wired. runZonedGuarded errors go to Datadog only. DDService.e creates a logger per call and sends error, stack, path and a request map (159 call sites). Provider errors go to both. setUserInfo sends id, name and email. Consent hard-coded granted. No sanitiser.
Works, unlike the agency apps' DatadogLog.e. Needs the PII cleaner and a consent setting.

RoRemoteConfigValue, 38 typed keys with defaults, live updates, a mapper from one Remote Config string. Plus 22 compile-time FEATURE_FLAG_* dart-defines, 3 of which no workflow passes. Fallback mapping bug when the fetch fails: roFfNotification and roFfAllowNewVersionOfTaxStatus both read featureFlagActivityContact (app_controller.dart:236,242).
Good shape. Fix the fallback bug, retire the compile-time flags into the catalogue.
dio adapter behind a client interface, typed exceptions.

core.HttpClient (dio, 30 s timeouts, pin interceptor when a fingerprint is set). Two auth decorators that refresh before every call and clear the session on 401. No retry, no request-id header, Krakend providers unused. datadog_tracking_http_client traces first-party hosts. System proxy honoured outside prod.
Same chain as the agency apps, from the same core once it is one package again.
Everspin RASP, CodeMix, build registration, device fingerprint, screen-capture guard, pinning.

Close UAT again, pin and obfuscate SIT, wire or delete the KernelSU check, set allowBackup false, add Play Integrity with the other repos. RASP vendor with the other three.
ui_theme in 316 files, identical to the agency copy. Raw Colors. on 39 lines.
